description:
Xiaomi MiMo AI desktop client

The Xiaomi MiMo AI desktop client. Chat freely, create boldly, and bring ideas to life.
Domestic edition: explicit watermark removal.
System task notifications with badge integration.
SVG shape, text, and region annotation.
Collapsible thinking steps; one-click TeX copy for formulas.
Clickable URLs in web-read steps, with source links.
Auto image compression; faster long-session and sidebar rendering.
Context usage tracks the main session only; subagent tokens no longer overwrite the HUD.
Sidebar priority cue is now a numberless blue dot.
Fix Windows stream body not updating and sidebar scroll white flash.
Delete local sessions from the engine to prevent sync resurrection.
source: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.
